Frontend: full Create flow tested end-to-end as the seeded user lumen_admin@lumen.app — Landing testids verified (hero-badge, hero-cta, step-1/2/3, occ-*, test-0/1/2, final-cta), Register → /lumen/app/home, Login → /lumen/app/home, Create wizard step 1→5 (occasion=Happy Birthday, recipient=Mum), GPT-5.2 generated a 341-char heartfelt script in ~4s, style/record/send steps each transition cleanly, send produced send-success card with /lumen/share/{token} URL, Library lists the created moment, Billing buy-lumen_1h redirects to checkout.stripe.com (US$9.90), public /lumen/share/70MKhav7UJy23g renders 'Lumen Admin sent you love.' with full script, 2 VIEWS counter, watermark badge — all without auth.

minor.issue: Code-quality only: handler calls find_one({share_token: token}) THREE times (once for doc, once for sender lookup, and a redundant inner find_one inside ObjectId(...) — see lumen.py:500). Functional but should cache the doc in a local var. No defect surfaced.
No brute-force lockout on Lumen login endpoint (unlike LensFlow /api/auth/login). Consider parity for production.

critical_code_review_comments: lumen.py:500 — duplicated find_one({share_token}) calls inside public_share handler. Refactor to: `doc = await _db().lumen_moments.find_one({...}); sender = await _db().lumen_users.find_one({_id: ObjectId(doc['user_id'])})`. Saves one round-trip.
lumen.py auth endpoints have no rate limiting / brute force protection (LensFlow has it on /api/auth/login). Recommend adding for parity.
lumen.py is 614 lines — still within reason but consider splitting payments/share/catalogs into separate modules if it grows further.
lumen_token cookie uses `secure=False` — fine for dev/k8s-ingress, must be flipped to True in real production behind HTTPS.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (landing, register, login, full Create wizard with live GPT-5.2, library, billing→Stripe, public share)
